firm_data.firm_description: Traub Lieberman Straus & Shrewsberry LLP is a client-focused law firm that meets the diverse needs of the insurance industry. They provide services including claim and coverage analysis, complex dispute resolution, and policy drafting.
notable_facts: Recognized for success in guiding insurance companies and their insureds for 30 years.
The firm has expanded nationally, enabling them to provide a full range of services throughout the U.S. across 17 practice areas.

email.subject: AI for Traub Lieberman, built for insurance-focused firms
email.body:
Hi there,

Traub Lieberman has built a notable practice around insurance claim and coverage analysis, complex dispute resolution, and policy drafting since 1996. That specialization requires precision and efficiency at scale, especially across the claims-heavy work your firm handles.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of specialized practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the White Plains area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on insurance matters.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
